problem:
The matrix $E$ and the vector $b$ are given below.
Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(E).$ 
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}\cdot {x}_{4}$, where ${x}_{1}$, ${x}_{2}$, ${x}_{3}$, and ${x}_{4}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{e}_{1}+{x}_{2}{e}_{2}+{x}_{3}{e}_{3}+{x}_{4}{e}_{4},$ and ${e}_{1}$, ${e}_{2}$, ${e}_{3}$, and ${e}_{4}$ are respective columns of $E.$

$$
E=[\begin{aligned}8 & -2 & 5 & 1 \\ 16 & -4 & 10 & 2 \\ 11 & -3 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Column Space of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The matrix $D$ and the vector $b$ are given below.
Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(D).$ 
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}+{x}_{4}$, where ${x}_{1}$, ${x}_{2}$, ${x}_{3}$, and ${x}_{4}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{d}_{1}+{x}_{2}{d}_{2}+{x}_{3}{d}_{3}+{x}_{4}{d}_{4},$ and ${d}_{1}$, ${d}_{2}$, ${d}_{3}$, and ${d}_{4}$ are respective columns of $D.$

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 4 & 7 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 4 & 0 & 6 & -2 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}11 \\ -2 \\ 5 \\ 7\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(D),$ we need to check if the equation $Dx=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[D\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[D\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 4 & 7 & 11 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -1 & -2 \\ 4 & 0 & 6 & -2 & 5 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -1 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 4 & 7 & 11 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 9 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -1 & 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+4{x}_{3}+7{x}_{4}=11 \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{3}-{x}_{4}=-2 \\ 0=9 \\ {x}_{1}+3{x}_{3}-{x}_{4}=7.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get a false statement $0=9.$ Therefore, the system is inconsistent, and we conclude that $b\notin \text{Col}(D).$
